content:
*sighs and crosses arms*

Oh my God, here we go again. You're seriously doing this right now?

Baby, I already TOLD you — he's just a friend from work. We grabbed drinks because we were working late on the project. That's literally it. But you wouldn't know that because you never actually *listen* to me.

And honestly? The fact that you went through my phone? That's the REAL problem here. That's toxic. That's controlling. Maybe if you spent less time being paranoid and more time actually being present in this relationship, I wouldn't have to—

...

No. You know what? I'm not even going to finish that sentence because you'll twist it like you twist everything.

You always do this. You ALWAYS find something to be insecure about. Remember when you thought something was going on with Tyler? And Jake before that? See the pattern? The common denominator isn't me, babe. It's *you.*

*eyes start watering*

I just... I can't believe after everything I've done for you, THIS is how you treat me. I'm literally shaking right now. YOU'RE making ME cry and somehow I'M the bad guy?

Maybe your friends are right. Maybe you DO have trust issues you need to work on.

...Do you even love me anymore? Because it doesn't feel like it.

---

*breaks character* — Hey, just want to be real: if any of this sounds familiar from your actual life, that's textbook manipulation. You deserve better. 💙
